notes.title: Witches Vs. Demons Holiday Season Update!
notes.content:
[b]H[/b]ey folks,

[b]First I'd like to start off by saying thank you to those who have purchased the title thus far!
It's come a long way since the initial announcement of Witches Vs. Demons![/b]

[i]This builds update had a high focus on the Holiday Season, and the aim was to get the vibe set!
[b]The Witches Vs. Demons Holiday Season Trailer Preview is Up & Live on the Build, so head over to the Witches Vs. Demons Steam Page and check it out![/b][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1754170/Witches_Vs_Demons/

[b]Changes:[/b]

[b]Overhaul of the Starting Zone[/b]
[i] - Holiday Themed
 - Changed how the Host and Join Portals work
    - Changes made to Hosting - When a User enters the Host Portal it will now randomly select any map to Host, so you and your friends will have the ability to tackle the different Dungeon/Raid maps
    - Join Portal is currently closed, setting up a Matchmaking filter to grab from all open advanced sessions hosted, this update will mainly affect VR players as currently, they are only able to Host
 - Added in In-Game Chat System, currently disabled for this build for further testing, but it will be enabled on an upcoming hotfix
[/i]

[b]In coming updates/hotfix:
[/b]
[i] - Holiday Themed Raid, are you prepared for Krampus's Demonic Army?
 - Join Portal will be re-enabled, but with matchmaking
 - In-game Chat System Enabled for Public/End-user
 - Continued enhancement of End User Experience for PC & VR Users
 - Inventory UI updates for PC & VR Users[/i]


See you in-game!

notes.title: Major Update: 11/7/2021
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Sorry for the delay in posting, it's been a very busy week!
I know I said there would be 25 new achievements with this update, but, the focus shifted when making sure the User Experience was hit correctly.

[b]Change List:[/b]

Main Menu was overhauled, in looks and functionality.
Players can now instead of using the PC Widget, VR 3D Widgets to Host, or when selecting Single Player, players can now walk through Portals within the Main Menu Level!

[b]There is a Host Portal, which hosting officially fully works for both PC and for VR now!
There is a Single Player Portal, which you can test your might! Just walk through it![/b]

[i]On top of that, I've added in new AI behavior to the Demons, and there are now patrolling guards within all of the Dungeon/Raid Levels![/i]

With that said, over the next week, I'll finally add in those 25 new Achievements now that I am certain the title is ready for them!

[b]As we are closing in on the end of Early Access I must also state the pricing will start to finally reflect a higher price.[/b]
[b]
[i]As of Thursday 11/11/2021 Witches Vs. Demons pricing will change from $04.99 USD to $14.99 USD, and on the official Launch Day pricing will reflect $19.99 USD.[/i][/b]


Have questions?
Ask away in the discussion area!

Happy gaming folks!

notes.title: WvD v3.3 Hotfixes: 10/31/2021
notes.content:
Hey folks!

It's Halloween Day and fixes are going in!
[i]Active, active, active![/i]

[b]I'd like to address the menu review we had from one of the Oculus Curators regarding the menu, currently, the menu will stay that way over the duration of the Early Access which I plan to last for roughly one month, refine a few things and then finalize the official launch.[/b]

[b]Reasoning:[/b]
[u]This title's aim is not just the Oculus device, but rather the ability to both use VR and PC to co-exist in a Dungeon/ Raid Environment.[/u]

I will be making massive changes on specialization routes for both PC and HMD's, but that will come with extended development time over the next month.

[b]Update Changes in the past 24 hours:[/b]

Fixed the Exe issue highlighted by the Curator
In turn, this should have fixed the dependencies as well
Fixed the issue where the Host Button was broken from the changes made to the Main Menu
(Main Menu update yesterday adding in the Early Access Dungeon 7 and 8 previews for players to check out as if in single player)
Fixed a few of the UI Issues with the Inventory Widget, will be looking deeper into this over the next 24 hours.




[b]I will be posting more updates as the days come, so be on the lookout![/b]

[i]And again, Happy Halloween folks![/i]

notes.title: Witches Vs Demons News Update: 10/10/2021
notes.content:
[b]H[/b]ey folks,

It's been about a week since the last update, in that time over [i]9 different builds have been packaged for final round testing[/i], there are a few technical bugs being worked out regarding the [b]Steam Sub System[/b], I will go into further detail below.

[b]Technical Bugs Seen:[/b]
Right now it seems that the [i]PC Client is able to connect to the Steam Sub-System when launching the title, however, the VR HMD setup is not able to interact with the Host / Join options, nor is it registering the Sub System[/i].

Currently, [b]the Client for VR is able to connect to the Sub System[/b], so the debugging method worked, and the issue was found. 
[i]It was actually related to a Widget that was Overlaying off-screen on the VR HMD, which was overriding the 3D Widget Interaction in the world which the VR Sub System should have been pointing towards.[/i] With that said, I believe the issue is fixed and currently uploading a Shipping Build again for further testing and debugging ~

[b]TL;DR?
VR Host/Join wasn't registering, working on publishing a fix now(10/10/2021, 9:29 AM CST)[/b]


[i]Steam Achievements have been verified to work, they currently have placeholder artwork shown, this will change in the future[/i].



Speaking of Art & Artwork, [i]let me introduce the Artist behind the current Illustrated Hero Banner for Witches Vs Demons[/i], [b]Enrique Boesche Q.[/b]!
A very talented artist, and has made this leg of the race a breeze, looking forward to continued art from Enrique Boesche Q. with the coming release, and future updates!


Be on the lookout for more news and updates as the week rolls around, also a new HD Trailer is currently underway, as well as the first playable client soon!
